equivalence_rules: The stochastic adversarial penetration model may be represented by an expected-value objective or by an evaluator/simulation expectation, as long as robust max-min semantics are not introduced.
The sequential DQN allocation process is a policy-generation algorithm; the mathematical assignment model remains a binary missile-target allocation.
The optional cost objective should be represented as a second objective only for MOMTA samples.
algorithm_boundary: PODRL, DQN state-action design, fair sample and reward shaping are learning/solution machinery, not the mathematical MTA/AMTA formulation
public_private_boundary: All planted assignments, destruction schemes, sampled stochastic outcomes, objective values and algorithm traces are private validation only.
